description: Model mapped to lmdbA whose on* scripts also write lmdbB and lmdbSmall, separate LMDB environments.

Order.description: Default processing writes lmdbA. onAddObject and onDeleteObject also write lmdbB.

auditCount.description: Read from lmdbB while lmdbA's read of this object is still open.

OrderThrow.description: Writes lmdbB and lmdbA, then throws: the request aborts both.

OrderFillSmall.description: Fills lmdbSmall until a write fails with MDB_MAP_FULL, then lets default processing write lmdbA. lmdbSmall's commit fails at the end of the request; lmdbA's still happens.

OrderSelfNote.description: onAddObject and onDeleteObject also write the mapped adapter, lmdbA, inside the model's own lmdbA transaction.

noteCount.description: Read lmdbA again while the model's read of this object from lmdbA is open.
